topic: Data linking and session recalculation process
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on ensuring accurate historical data linkage following changes in sensor deployment. It was determined that if the existing 72 links added on 2026-02-19 were not deleted, they could be used to cover the period from 2025-11-13 through 2026-02-19.

To handle data updates and prevent duplication during model recalculation, someone advised using a specific SQL script (`core.device_session_agg_dev`) instead of `device_session`.

[me] was unsure about the integrity of the current setup and requested a link for verification.
decisions: Use existing 72 links to cover data from 2025-11-13 to 2026-02-19.
action_items: When recalculating the model, ensure the `core.device_session_agg_dev` script is used instead of `device_session` to prevent duplicates.
[p1] to provide a link for verification.
